honda-civic-2016-brochure-source07.locator: American Honda US 2016 Civic brochure mirrored as publisher-authored PDF, p9 Civic SEDAN Specifications: LX 2.0 158hp 6MT/CVT, EX 2.0 standard CVT, EX-T/EX-L/Touring 1.5 turbo 174hp 162lb-ft inherited CVT; p4 turbo and 2016 economy. Coupe preview is excluded.

honda-civic-2017-facts-source07.locator: Honda 2017 Civic Facts Guide, PDF pp3-6 Sedan trim walk, pp58-61 SEDAN SPECIFICATIONS & FEATURES: 2.0 LX 6MT/CVT and EX CVT; 1.5 EX-T 6MT/CVT with torque split 167/162lb-ft, EX-L/Touring CVT; Si Sedan 205hp 6MT; dimensions and 5 seats. Coupe/Hatch are separate sections.

honda-civic-2018-trimwalk-source07.locator: Honda 2018 Civic Sedan TRIM WALK PDF pp1-3: LX 2.0 158hp 6MT/CVT, EX 2.0 standard CVT, EX-T 1.5 turbo 174hp 6MT/CVT with torque split 167/162lb-ft, EX-L/Touring CVT, Si Sedan 205hp 6MT; source is explicitly Sedan, not Coupe or Hatch.

honda-civic-2016-gen-source07.publisher: Honda Motor Co., Ltd. / American Honda Motor Co., Inc.
honda-civic-2016-gen-source07.locator: Honda September 2015 announcement explicitly calls the all-new 2016 North American Civic Sedan 10th generation and separates planned sedan/coupe/hatch/Si variants; generation identity only, annual transmission applicability comes from year-specific docs.

families.scope_note: Only US 10th-generation Civic four-door Sedan annual LX, EX, EX-T, EX-L, Touring and 2017-18 Si joint configurations documented by Honda, EPA 4Dr tuple confirms FWD. The 2016 turbo manual is absent; no coupe/hatch transfer.
exclude: Unreviewed trims, body configurations or exact-VIN identity
